_notes: PixelLab input for npm run art:pixellab (tools/art/pixellab.mjs, ADR 0009). One entry per asset. kind: character (board figure, 8 directions, create-character-pro-flash), object (board prop, 1 direction, create-object-pro-flash) or card (HUD/lobby/cut-in art, create-image-pro-flash). id: a unit id from sects.json > roster.units, or a scenery prop the castle field draws (packages/client/src/board.ts PROP_ART). size: 96 on the board, 128 for cards. palette: groups from effects.json > render.palette; colors: extra palette colours. animations: what each character gets once its figure exists (template mode bills 1 per direction under 100 px; estPerDirection is PixelLab's published price for the others). vfx: one effect per kit and per notable technique (/vfx, lite artist, 1 each), saved to art/vfx/. defaults.styleImage: an approved sprite (path from the repo root) every generation copies outline and shading from; null until one is approved. Output: packages/client/public/sprites/board/<id>/<direction>.png, board/<id>/anim/<name>/<direction>/<n>.png and card/<id>.png. Names in prompts are original; no Jin Yong / Gu Long names.
